Municipal employee suspended after drunk conduct video goes viral

A municipal employee in Uttar Pradesh has been suspended following the viral circulation of a video depicting him making obscene gestures while reportedly intoxicated. Separately, a Circle Inspector (CI) in Kerala was suspended for creating a ruckus while allegedly drunk. These incidents highlight issues of public conduct among officials.
